The charging station provides an alternating current that is converted into direct current within the EV's onboard charging system, which is then stored in the battery. DC fast charging, on the other hand, is a quicker method that can recharge an EV battery from 0 to 80% in just 30 minutes. This method uses a DC fast charging station that provides direct current to the EV's battery, bypassing the onboard charging system. In simple terms, AC charging is a slower and more convenient method, while DC fast charging is a quicker, but less common method. Can I charge my car in the rainy season using your charger?
